args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

Clear the upload problem state by calling setProblem(null) inside the file input's onChange handler when a new file is chosen, so that old error messages do not persist until the next submit.
args.title: Clear problem state on file change in UploadForm.tsx

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/UploadForm.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file input's onChange handler in UploadForm.tsx updates the file state without clearing the existing problem state, which causes old error messages to persist until the next submit. We should clear the upload problem state by calling setProblem(null) when a new file is chosen.

label: question
file: none
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Amounts are stored as exact integers in minor units (cents, yen, etc.) in the database, avoiding floating-point rounding errors, as seen in src/db/client.ts. Currencies with no minor units (like JPY) are specifically identified and handled with zero minor digits in src/util/money.ts.

args.title: Support Greek and Cyrillic characters in export filenames
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Modify formatExportFilename or slugify (or introduce a filename-safe normalization supporting Greek and Cyrillic) in src/exportUtils.ts or src/util/strings.ts so that non-Latin names are not completely stripped.

label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/exportUtils.ts calls slugify(reportName) which uses regex /[^a-z0-9]+/g, stripping all non-Latin characters such as Greek and Cyrillic. Modify formatExportFilename or slugify (or introduce a filename-safe normalization supporting Greek and Cyrillic) in src/exportUtils.ts or src/util/strings.ts so that non-Latin names are not completely stripped.
